claims: - The standard picture keeps passing new tests: counts of 16,000 galaxy clusters with lensing and clustering agree with the cosmic background's parameters (DES Collaboration 2025, Phys. Rev. D 112, 083535, doi:10.1103/3dzh-d8f5).

DES Collaboration (Abbott, T. M. C. et al.) 2025, Phys. Rev. D 112, 083535: Dark Energy Survey year 3, cosmological constraints from cluster abundances, weak lensing and galaxy clustering doi:10.1103/3dzh-d8f5
